page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance class suitable for general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight web serving, application hosting, and microservices that require stable CPU performance but do not demand local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration.
